content: Bakhaka ba Yesu
Tala ndala ya Yesu Kidisitu
, mwana wa Tavidi
yi mwana wa Bulahami.
Bulahami kábuta Yizaki amana Yizaki kábuta Yakobi; Yakobi kábuta Yuta yi baphangi bandi ba bayakala;
Yuta kábuta Fwalesi yi Zala, ngudi wa bawu Thamadi; Fwalesi kábuta Hesiloni; Hesiloni kábuta Alami;
Alami kábuta Aminatabi; Aminatabi wábuta Nasoni; Nasoni kábuta Salamani;
amana Salamani kábuta Bowasi, ngudi wandi Lahabi; Bowasi kábuta Yobedi ngudi wandi Luti; Yobedi kábuta Yese
Yese kábuta Tavidi wuna wákituka kyamvu. Tavidi Kábuta Solumoni, yi mukhetu wa Wudiye;
Solumoni kábuta Lobuwami; Lobuwami kábuta Abiya; Abiya kábuta Azafu;
Azafu kábuta Yosafati; Yosafati kábuta Yolami; Yolami kábuta Ozyasi;
Ozyasi kábuta Yowatami; Yowatami kábuta Akhazi; Akhazi kábuta Ezekyasi;
Ezekyasi kábuta Manase; Manase kábuta Amosi; Amosi kábuta Yozyasi;
Yozyasi kábuta Yekonya yi baphangi bandi ba bayakala; mu tangwa bákala mu tsi ya kinzenza ku Babiloni.
Amana kunima dya kukota mu kinzenza ku Babiloni, Yekonya kábuta Salasyedi; Salasyedi kábuta Zolubabedi;
Zolubabedi kábuta Abiwudi, Abiwudi kábuta Edyakimi; Edyakimi kábuta Azolu,
Azolu kábuta Satoki; Satoki kábuta Akimi; Akimi kábuta Ediwudi;
Ediwudi kábuta Eleyazadi; Eleyazadi kábuta Matani; Matani kábuta Yakobi;
Yakobi kábuta Yozefu, yakala dya Madiya, kwena Madiya kwábutuka Yesu, wuna bisi tela Kidisitu.

Disongidila, makula kumi yi maya máhita, tukidila Bulahami tii yi kuna Tavidi, amana makula kumi yi maya hika máhyoka, tukidila Tavidi tii yi kuna kinzenza kya ku Babiloni, amana makula kumi yi maya máhyoka tukidila mu kinzenza kya ku Babiloni tii yi kuna Kidisitu.
Lubutuku lwa Yesu Kidisitu
Amana tala buna lwákadila lubutuku lwa Yesu Kidisitu. Madiya, ngudi wandi, kákala mbayi wa Yozefu; ku thwala ya kikhunda kya lutu lwa bawu, wádimona ku vumu mu ngolu za Kitembu kyatoma.
Amana Yozefu, yakala dyandi
, kakala wabukheti yi wasungama amana kátondaku kumuyukisa tsoni ha mbasi, kahanga, wubongi dibanza dya kumuyambula mu kitsweki.

Bwosu kákalabwa banza, hanga wanzyo wa Pfumu wumulubwakidi mu ndosi amana wuzimbudi: «Yozefu, mwana wa Tavidi, kalaku yi bweya bwa kutambula, Madiya, hanga mukhetu waku, mukuma kifundu kya mwana wuna kayimiti, kwena Kitembu Kyatoma kitukini.
Amana kabúta mwana mosi wa yakala, amana wamutediki mu khumbu ya Yesu
, mukuma yandi wahúlula kikanda kyandi ku masumu mandi.»
Moosu mana máhangama ndangu malungila mana kázimbula Pfumu mu nzila ya mbikudi:

content.text: «Ndumba wakonda kedi zaya yakala, kayímita vumu amana kabúta mwana mosi wa yakala,
amana bamútediki mu khumbu ya Manwedi.»

content: Disongidila: «Nzambi kenina ha kimosi yi betu.»
Mu kutokama kwandi, Yozefu wáhanga buna kámulongikila wanzyo wa Pfumu, amana wátambula mukhetu wandi.
Kaasi kámuzayaku lutu tii yi kuna kabutila mwana mosi wa yakala, wuna káheka yandi khumbu ya Yesu.

footnotes.text: Muhowu wawu "Kidisitu" wubati hana kifwanisu kya kyamvu yi muhuludi wuna kasila Nzambi mu kutuma.
Mu khama tsambwadi za mvula, ku thwala Yesu, Nzambi wasila ni Masiya mwana wa kyamvu Tavidi kakala. (Yes 9:6-7; 11:1-5; Yel 23:5)
Yozefu kabanza ni mbongi kata mukhetu wandi. Disongidila, kazolaku hika kumukwela.
Disongidila dya khumbu ya Yesu «Nzambi kisi hulula».
